CustomField.label: Pass Condition (Formula)
CustomField.description: Salesforce formula syntax used only when Check Type is Check fields on this record. Return true (pass) or false (fail), e.g. NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCity)). For list checks ("List includes any of" / "List excludes all of"), use Value To Test (list checks only) instead. Not used for any other Check Type.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check fields on this record: return true/false (e.g. NOT(ISBLANK(BillingCity))). For list checks ("List includes any of"/"List excludes all of"), use Value To Test (list checks only) instead.
